subject: paper:katzman-2017-comorbidity
quote: As many as 80% of adults with ADHD have at least one coexisting psychiatric disorder
rationale: Verbatim from the open-access BMC Psychiatry full text (PMC5567978), reused here as the headline comorbidity figure — most adults with ADHD have a co-occurring disorder.

subject: paper:kessler-2006-ncs-r
quote: Adult ADHD was highly comorbid with many other DSM-IV disorders assessed in the survey and was associated with substantial role impairment.
rationale: Verbatim from the MEDLINE abstract, reused here from the anxiety note. Nationally representative corroboration that adult ADHD co-occurs broadly with other disorders.

subject: paper:lee-2011
quote: Children with ADHD were also more likely to develop disorders of abuse/dependence for nicotine, alcohol, marijuana, cocaine, and other substances (i.e., unspecified).
rationale: Verbatim from the MEDLINE abstract. Prospective meta-analytic evidence that childhood ADHD raises risk of later substance abuse/dependence across drug classes.

subject: paper:van-emmerik-2012
quote: Overall, 23.1% (CI: 19.4-27.2%) of all SUD subjects met DSM-criteria for comorbid ADHD.
rationale: Verbatim from the MEDLINE abstract. The reciprocal direction — ADHD is present in roughly a quarter of substance-use-disorder patients — establishing the two-way link.
